RESEARCH_MUNICIPALITY.notes: Seattle operates under a mayor-council form of government. The Mayor is elected citywide. The City Council consists of nine members; seven are elected by district, and two are elected at-large (Positions 8 and 9). Sara Nelson serves as the Council President. Recent changes in the City Council include Mark Solomon being appointed to District 2 after Tammy Morales's resignation, and Debora Juarez being appointed to District 5 after Cathy Moore's resignation.
